name: USS Fletcher

propulsion._speedNote: 38 knots is the commonly quoted design figure at trial displacement. 36.5 is the realistic deep-load speed and is used here, since the simulation fights ships at full load.

sources: Friedman, US Destroyers: An Illustrated Design History (2004)

confidence.maxSpeedKn: medium — 36.5 to 38 knots depending on load
confidence.tacticalDiameterLengths: low — no trial figure to hand; 3.5 lengths is typical for a single-rudder destroyer of this size

notes: The archetypal US wartime destroyer: flush-decked, very fine, and with essentially no armour. Her survivability comes from being small and fast, not from protection.
